fullDescription: High-end editorial magazine design system for digital storytelling, featuring a 'Dark Forest' and 'Gold' color palette. This style utilizes sophisticated editorial typography with Fraunces serif and Inter sans-serif pairing. The layout mimics a physical magazine with a 1:1.414 aspect ratio (A4 proportions), paper-grain textures, and generous negative space. It is ideal for luxury hospitality, artisanal food and beverage, boutique SaaS partnerships, and high-value brand storytelling. Key visual motifs include massive serif headlines, drop caps, bento-style feature grids, and QR-integrated conversion cards.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated digital magazine design system with an editorial 'Dark Forest' aesthetic, combining high-contrast typography, organic paper textures, and structured bento-grid components for a premium storytelling experience.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a design system based on a high-end editorial magazine. Colors: primary background 'Forest Green' (#0a2f17), secondary background 'Cream' (#faf5e6), primary accent 'Gold' (#eebc4a), secondary accent 'Muted Gold' (#b28a3c), and 'Mint' highlights (#e8f3ec). Typography: Use 'Fraunces' (serif, weights 400-900) for headlines with letter-spacing -0.02em; use 'Inter' (sans-serif, weights 400-900) for body and metadata. UI Elements: Container border-radius at 2.5rem (40px); large, soft shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.15)); and thin borders (1px) at 10% opacity white or forest. Implement a 'Paper Grain' overlay using an SVG filter (feTurbulence baseFrequency='0.65' at 0.04 opacity). Animations: Smooth 105% scale on hover for buttons, subtle rotation (-2deg) on featured images, and view-transitions for page navigation.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Magazine Cover (Page 1)
Create a high-impact cover layout. Header: Left-aligned logo (h-20, white filter) with uppercase metadata (tracking 0.3em); right-aligned pill-shaped badge in Gold. Hero: Headline in Fraunces 900 (7xl/8xl), leading-0.85, using italics for emphasis. Feature an image container with rounded-40px corners, object-contain food photography, and a heavy drop shadow. Footer: Left-aligned call-to-action button (Gold) and right-aligned minimal icon.

### Editorial Story (Page 2)
Design a two-column editorial layout on a Cream (#faf5e6) background. Left column: Lead paragraph in bold 20px text followed by body text using a large 4.8rem Fraunces drop cap in #b28a3c. Right column: Featured image rotated -2 degrees inside a 4px white border 'Polaroid' frame, plus sidebar cards with #e8f3ec background and 8px accent borders.

### Feature/Bento Grid (Page 3)
Implement a hybrid service/feature page. Top: Serif headline with high-tracking subheads. Middle: Two-column grid containing a 'Checklist' card (white background, gold bullets, serif sub-headlines) and a 'Value Prop' card (mint background, checkmark icons). Bottom: A full-width 'Dark Forest' (#0a2f17) conversion banner with 40px padding, gold primary buttons, and border-only secondary buttons.

### Conversion & QR Outro (Page 4)
Final conversion layout with centered serif header. Grid: Three-column feature boxes with white icons on mint circles. Conversion: Two large white cards (border-radius 40px) containing QR codes, tracking-heavy metadata, and full-width buttons. Footer: Large italic serif 'Magazine Title' branding with tiny metadata tracking 0.6em.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Editorial Drop Cap — A high-impact initial letter for long-form content.
Float first letter left; font-size 4.8rem; line-height 0.8; padding-top 4px; padding-right 10px; font-family 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight 900; color #b28a3c.

### Paper Grain Overlay — SVG-based texture for tactile feel.
Absolute position fill; opacity 0.04; pointer-events none; background-image using feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.65; z-index high.

### Interactive QR Card — Physical-to-digital bridge component.
White background container; rounded-40px; border 1px forest-5%; flex-col items-center; centered QR image with shadow-xl; gold primary button; metadata font-size 10px font-black uppercase tracking-widest.

Typography relies on the high-contrast Fraunces serif for expressive headlines and Inter for functional UI elements. Layouts utilize deep shadows (0 50px 100px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)) and large border radii (2.5rem) to create a contemporary 'soft-brutalist' editorial feel.
